dct_title_s: AMERICA SEPTENTRIONALIS, Novissima. [and] AMERICA MERIDIONALIS, accuratissima
dct_description_sm: P Schenk ex: Amsteloed: cum Privil.
California as an island on second Sanson model, with indented northern coast. Peninsula named Aguebla de Cato on mainland to northeast. Quiri Regio and Insule Salomonis in Mar del Zur.
Double title, each within decorative cartouche (upper and lower left).
Engraved by: P Schenk ex: Amsteloed: cum Privil. (below lower cartouche).
Issued in: Atlas Contractus / Petri Schenk, [ca.1700 and later].
